title: dt2: DataTables v2 for Shiny for Python (anywidget binding)
description: dt2 is the Python port of the R DT2 package: an anywidget binding for DataTables v2, designed for Shiny for Python and usable in Jupyter. It configures DataTables via plain Python (1:1 with the JS API), reusing the same DataTables runtime (2.3.4) and extensions as the R package, and supports the full feature set: a chainable Options builder, all 15 DataTables extensions, server-side processing, a Python-to-table proxy, table events, and inline row inputs.
